source_clause: PVAL3.) To activate Valet Mode a 4 digit one-time PIN is required to be entered.
leaf_desc_037: PVAL3.) To activate Valet Mode a 4 digit one-time PIN is required to be entered.
reasoning: 驗證目標：12.3（PVAL3）—— 啟用 Valet Mode 須輸入 4 位一次性 PIN。關鍵情境條件：ER2 明寫「在啟用之前」要求 PIN ——若寫成「輸入 PIN 後啟用」，一個先啟用再問 PIN 之實作也會通過（§7）。為什麼這樣切：停用側之同一 PIN 屬 12.3.1，PIN 錯誤之次數上限屬 12.9，皆不在本條。

tcs.tc_title: Four-digit PIN required to activate Valet Mode
tcs.test_item:
Four-digit PIN required to activate Valet Mode
(Verifies that a four-digit one-time PIN is required to activate Valet Mode)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. Valet Mode is not active
2. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.input_test_data: PIN: a 4-digit one-time PIN chosen at activation
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the “All Profiles” tab and press the Valet Mode button
2. Read the screen and check that a 4-digit PIN entry is required
3. Enter a 4-digit PIN and confirm
4. Read the screen and check that Valet Mode is active
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Valet Mode activation is started
2. A 4-digit PIN entry is requested before activation
3. The 4-digit PIN is accepted
4. Valet Mode is active
tcs.priority_basis: 啟用之 PIN —— Valet Mode 之防護本身
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
